name: GET /api/dialer/caller-ids - List the tenant's caller-ID pool
description: Lists the pool (by number) with attestation, active flag and last_used_at, optionally filtered by active=true|false (e6ae5703-37a6-4d27-a7d5-23ec80c4a001#AC3). Dispatch picks each outbound call's caller ID from the tenant's ACTIVE pool — a number in the destination's NANP area code first (local presence), then the least recently used — narrowed to the campaign's caller_id_pool when set, and stores it as the call's from_number with caller_id_attestation. A from number the caller names must be an active pool number (else refused caller_id_not_owned); with no usable number the call is refused no_caller_id and its slot released.

testCases.name: Reject an active filter that is not true/false

errorCases.message: active must be true or false
